name: review_sched
desc: [自主神经] 间隔重复调度(SM-2:1/3/7/16/35/90天)：add排入/due到期清单/done复习推进
cmd: A=$action; PY=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/python3; B=/data/lemonbrain/autonomic; case "$A" in add) /system/bin/timeout 20 $PY $B/review_sched.py add $id $title;; done) /system/bin/timeout 20 $PY $B/review_sched.py done $id;; *) /system/bin/timeout 20 $PY $B/review_sched.py due;; esac
